race.title: All-Weather Championship Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
race.verdict: OXFORD CIRCUS is really starting to find his feet for this yard and looks up to completing a hat-trick. Ice Show is worth another chance having shown improved form to score over C&D 2 starts back and is next best ahead of Kit Gabriel , who drops into a 0-65 for the first time. OXFORD CIRCUS (IRE) ICE SHOW KIT GABRIEL (IRE)
